description: This file defines classes and functions related to distributed checkpointing extensions, including stream transformations like ZStandard compression, and manages extension registration and instantiation based on descriptors.

classes.name: Extension
classes.description: Abstract base class for checkpointing extensions, providing methods for descriptor handling.

classes.name: StreamTransformExtension
classes.description: Abstract class for stream transformation extensions, such as compression or encryption.

classes.name: ZStandard
classes.description: Implementation of a stream transform extension for ZStandard compression, with methods for availability check, descriptor handling, and stream transformation.

classes.name: ExtensionRegistry
classes.description: Manages registration and instantiation of extension classes based on descriptors.

methods.name: is_available
methods.description: Checks if ZStandard compression modules are available.

methods.name: from_descriptor
methods.description: Creates a ZStandard extension instance from a version string.

methods.name: registry_name
methods.description: Returns the registry name for ZStandard extension.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the ExtensionRegistry with default extensions.

methods.name: from_descriptor_list
methods.description: Creates extension instances from a list of descriptor strings.
